mapper.select: SELECT input_revision FROM application_preparation WHERE id = #{preparationId} AND owner_account_id = #{ownerId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT f.id, f.preparation_id, f.section_key, f.field_key, f.fact_status, f.value_text, f.source_text, f.input_revision, f.created_at, f.updated_at FROM application_preparation_fact f INNER JOIN application_preparation p ON p.id = f.preparation_id WHERE f.preparation_id = #{preparationId} AND p.owner_account_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY f.section_key, f.id

SELECT id, preparation_id, section_key, field_key, fact_status, value_text, source_text, input_revision, created_at, updated_at FROM application_preparation_fact WHERE preparation_id = #{preparationId} AND section_key = #{sectionKey} ORDER BY id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM application_preparation_fact WHERE preparation_id = #{preparationId} AND section_key = #{sectionKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE application_preparation SET input_revision = #{nextRevision}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{preparationId} AND input_revision = #{expectedRevision}
mapper.select: SELECT id, preparation_id, section_key, input_revision, request_key, request_hash, run_status, input_json, output_json, failure_code, started_at, finished_at FROM application_preparation_interpretation_run WHERE preparation_id = #{preparationId} AND request_key = #{requestKey}
